outcome: The binary and ternary minimum means satisfy both source invariance identities but admit no genuine inverse quasi-arithmetic representation, refuting the literal continuous-mean classification without an added strictness hypothesis.
qualification: The original PDF labels this Conjecture 29 on printed page 26; the HTML conversion labels it Conjecture 26. The counterexample is non-strict and does not address a strengthened strict or analytic formulation. No mathematical discovery or priority claim is made.
title: Minimum means counterexample to unrestricted both-types classification
novelty: Literal continuous-mean formulation without added strictness; no strict/analytic classification result and no worldwide priority claim.
